frozen_note: Specified by H059 (HAILO10_200_SLICE_ROADMAP.md line 885: 'the rubric file is created and checksummed in this slice'); H059's remediation proved coherence but never wrote the file, so it is frozen here with H059's exact item set. Reused verbatim by H158/H186/H195.

items.description: Every generated token id is a valid vocabulary id: 0 <= id < 32000.
At least 3 complete sentences, each ending in terminal punctuation (. ! ?).
No single token id repeated more than 10 times consecutively.
At least 1 prompt-topic content word present (per-prompt list recorded in the proof JSON).
No NaN/Inf-derived garbage tokens: decoded text contains no U+FFFD replacement characters.
At least 80% English words against english_wordlist_v2.txt (370090 words; whitespace tokens, punctuation stripped, lowercased; numeric tokens count as English).

v1_1_changelog: H201 remediation: the v1 english_wordlist.txt (2674 words) lacked common English words (watched, ships, passengers, cargo, suspicious, behavior, obsessed, waiting, counting, ...), causing false english_ratio_ge_80 failures on human-verified coherent text (measured 47/62=0.76 on coherent Q8_0 output). v1.1 uses english_wordlist_v2.txt (370090 words = v1 + dwyl/english-words words_alpha.txt, deduplicated). Threshold unchanged (>=80%). All other items identical. The v1 files are preserved frozen.
